name: simpleboot
resume: CRAN simpleboot 1.1-8 is translated. one.boot, two.boot, and pairs_boot call the translated boot(). The linear-model bootstrap matches. loess.boot matches loess(surface='direct'); the default interpolated surface still differs, and that check is recorded with matches false. Residual resampling of a loess fit adds the resampled residual to the predictor, as the R source does.

functions.name: one.boot
functions.done: One-sample bootstrap through boot.boot. A studentized call nests another one_boot and appends the sample variance.

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(simpleboot))
stopifnot(packageDescription("simpleboot")$Version == "1.1-8")
x <- c(-0.62645381074233242, 0.18364332422208224, -0.83562861241004716, 1.5952808021377916, 0.32950777181536051, -0.82046838411801526, 0.48742905242848528, 0.73832470512921733, 0.57578135165349231, -0.30538838715635602, 1.511781168450848, 0.38984323641143109)
set.seed(2)
one <- function() one.boot(x, mean, R = 25)
warm <- one()

elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time()); one(); elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", warm$t), collapse = " "), "\n")
